description:
About the company
 Our client is a small software company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Design and deliver production AI features that take over intricate, document-heavy business processes. Carry projects from early experiments through to live release and ongoing refinement, partnering closely with founders and subject-matter experts. Contribute to the direction of the product through hands-on learning.
 What you'll do
 - Design and develop LLM-driven agent applications that automate multi-step financial processes.
 - Take responsibility for the full lifecycle: prototyping, evaluation, release, monitoring and continuous improvement based on user feedback.
 - Judge when plain rule-based code, assisted AI flows or fully autonomous agents best fit a given problem.
 - Sit alongside founders and domain experts to watch real work being done, spot weaknesses in the agent's context or design, and deliver fixes.
 - Build AI capabilities into the user experience so they feel natural and enjoyable to use, not just strong on technical metrics.
 - Help steer the product roadmap using what you learn from hands-on work with agent-based approaches.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - Roughly 1.5 to 4 years of professional software engineering experience in production environments, ideally at a high-growth startup or respected technology firm.
 - Prior experience as a founder, early employee or engineer in an early-stage company.
 - A history of creating new systems yourself rather than mainly wiring together existing tools.
 - Hands-on applied AI experience with LLMs, agents, retrieval or document-processing applications.
 - Ability to turn loosely defined problems into deployed solutions with measurable results.
 - Comfort collaborating directly with subject-matter experts.
 - Availability to work in person at the New York office.
 Bonus points
 - Background in finance or other regulated sectors that rely heavily on documents.
 - For earlier-career candidates, a strong academic background from a leading university.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 200,000 to 300,000 per year
 - Equity
 - Relocation support
 Location and work model
 - New York, NY, USA
 - On-site, 4-5 days per week in the office
 - Full-time
